anchor_selection: Count appearances in supplied target-pair metadata; descending count, lexical tie-break; no label or validation selection.
forecast_learner: Unchanged histogram learner, parameters and training preprocessing; all nonduplicate usable candidates admitted.
gate: Identity and shocks panels: >=0.002 over saved same-fold current_market. Joint: >=0.002 over both saved current_market and fitted identity-only. Required numerical admission and exact replay. Review only.
identity_features: For each anchor: signed membership (left minus right) and unsigned membership (left plus right).
numerical_features: For each anchor: its standardized current return times signed membership and unsigned membership. Unrelated targets get structural zero; missing observations on a member target stay NaN.
period_choice: Middle development fold selected after observing its weaker historical baseline, before these new scores. Not a fresh holdout or global multiplicity correction.
price_feature: Finite positive close/FX log return divided by trailing 63-row population standard deviation through t-1 (42 observations minimum, floor 1e-6), clipped to [-12,12].
